introHtml: When you need pet accessories that offer more than just branding, LED light features add a practical layer of safety and visibility. Whether you're outfitting a company dog park or handing out swag at a pet-friendly event, these items help keep pets seen after dark. Options like LED collars and leashes use bright, long-lasting lights that make your logo stand out while serving a real purpose for pet owners. It's a functional giveaway that gets used daily.
